title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SeasonProfile
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SeasonProfile. [COSEM] This class represents a season which is defined by its starting date and a specific day profile to be executed.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SeasonProfile'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasSeasonProfileName.description: Property. [COSEM] User defined name identifying the current season profile.

hasSeasonStart.description: Property. [COSEM] Starting time of the season profile. The current season profile is terminated by the starting time of the next season.

hasDayProfile.description: Relationship. [COSEM] Day profile for every day of the week of a season.

hasMondayProfile.description: Relationship (sub-property of hasDayProfile). It defines the day profile valid each Monday of the season.

hasTuesdayProfile.description: Relationship (sub-property of hasDayProfile). It defines the day profile valid each Tuesday of the season.

hasWednesdayProfile.description: Relationship (sub-property of hasDayProfile). It defines the day profile valid each Wednesday of the season.

hasThursdayProfile.description: Relationship (sub-property of hasDayProfile). It defines the day profile valid each Thursday of the season.

hasFridayProfile.description: Relationship (sub-property of hasDayProfile). It defines the day profile valid each Friday of the season.

hasSaturdayProfile.description: Relationship (sub-property of hasDayProfile). It defines the day profile valid each Saturday of the season.

hasSundayProfile.description: Relationship (sub-property of hasDayProfile). It defines the day profile valid each Sunday of the season.
